verdict.rationale: Rootly documents an official MCP server that implements the Model Context Protocol and exposes its incident data and actions as tools. It works with Cursor, Windsurf, Claude Code, Gemini CLI and any other MCP-compatible client, and named tools include find_related_incidents. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server, and documented setup and authentication details in the evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: The Rootly MCP Server implements the Model Context Protocol to expose Rootly incident data and actions as tools that any MCP-compatible client can use.
you can query incidents, check on-call schedules, find similar past incidents, and take action — all from within Cursor, Windsurf, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, or any other MCP-compatible environment.
**`find_related_incidents`** — uses TF-IDF similarity analysis to surface historically similar incidents
